summary: CSF categories now share a full-width aligned chart and numeric table, with URL sorting and scoped requirement drill-down. Organizational Tiers are in a separate keyboard tab with workspace-bound draft and save state.

verification.command: git diff --check -- apps/web/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx apps/web/src/pages/profile.css apps/web/src/lib/profile.ts apps/web/test/profile.test.ts
CSS variable references compared with generated and application CSS definitions

chart.table: Current and target profile by category

ui_contract.navigation: Requirement CodeTag links preserve canonical workspace, framework and Observatory select id.

review: Only server-projected inScope=true applicable outcomes without an explicit not-applicable status contribute to category levels, detail and status distribution.
Missing scope or state withholds category means and overall metrics; disabled and empty scopes render no numeric level.
Mean gap is positive target mean minus current mean on the chart scale. Below-target outcome counts retain individual shortfalls hidden by aggregate means.
Current requirement status and accepted valid evidence counts remain exactly those from the refreshed server state.
Fresh framework state polls every minute and uses existing canonical workspace query invalidation.
Tier answers, dirty flag and mutation state persist above unmounted TabPanels; canonical workspace component key resets all draft state.
Tier save success and deferred category-close focus are guarded against completion in an unmounted workspace instance.
Save failure retains answers with explicit error; loading and failed profile/meta/workspace queries render loading or retry instead of fabricated zeros.
All new CSS variables are defined; primary table and assessment text uses existing body typography tokens.
limitations: Browser execution, production build, screenshot inspection and combined full suites are lead-owned and were not run by this worker.
Narrow layouts retain table comparisons in named keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll regions; page overflow requires the lead browser check.
No backend, shared contracts, documentation, e2e, commit, push or deployment files were changed.
